notes: Units are Celsius/mm, matching every other file in this project (Open-Meteo's native units) -- NOT the Fahrenheit/inches shown in Investigator_Mode_Guideline.md's own contract example. 'ideal' (reference_preset_id) is the fixed reference point the dashboard's weather-scenario projection subtracts every other preset against; it is not itself a projected adjustment. A 'heat_wave' preset (95F/35C in the original spec) is deliberately excluded -- see PROGRESS.md's Deferred list and pipeline/elasticities.py's own SPARSE_GRID_CAVEAT: the elasticity fit it would extrapolate from has only 5 distinct training points and a sharp, likely-artifactual jump right at its own top observed value (18.7C), a qualitatively bigger problem than the milder extrapolation rain_day/snow_day already carry.
